proposed.explanation: Foreign consultants must satisfy three conditions under SPP 209: (1) obtain a Temporary/Special Permit from PRC, (2) secure DoLE work certification, and (3) collaborate with a local Registered Licensed Architect. This framework mirrors the general foreign architect requirements.
